record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie historical-input and candidate-output item embeddings. Initialize both tables identically, then train them independently; retain padding row zero and apply existing frequency attenuation only to historical inputs. Separate tables may resolve conflicting contextual and target-ranking gradients under pointwise logistic loss. Keep dimensions, features, causal backbone, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer unchanged. Update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer consistently; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie history-input and target-output embeddings across all four category models, initializing both tables identically with zero padding. Independent contextual and ranking gradients may improve representation under the existing pointwise loss. Frequency attenuation remains exclusive to historical inputs. The predictor writer already imports the updated model class and loads its full state dictionary, preserving checkpoint consistency.
